# Computer Elo

Computer Elo is a self-attested weekly computer-use game. Private activity stays with the user's own AI. Public resources provide rules, not computer history or permission to collect it.

- [Current scoring guide](https://computer-elo.vercel.app/rate.md): UTC week, rubric, evidence requirements, privacy boundary, and result JSON. No evidence means no score.
- [Connect your AI](https://computer-elo.vercel.app/connect): Reference link and optional read-only MCP setup.
- [MCP endpoint](https://computer-elo.vercel.app/mcp): Public scoring reference only; no account key needed and no write or history-access tools.
- [League](https://computer-elo.vercel.app): Choose a username, review and publish approved aggregates, and share a card.
